result.summary: Adds doc/notifications.md and references it in doc/README.md to explain Bitcoin Core's shell command notification options (-blocknotify, -walletnotify, -alertnotify, -startupnotify, and -shutdownnotify). The documentation highlights that commands execute in detached threads with no guaranteed execution or completion ordering.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core's shell notification options execute commands asynchronously without ordering guarantees, but this behavior was only discoverable by reading source code. External scripts relying on sequential notifications can experience subtle race conditions.

result.card: This pull request adds doc/notifications.md to document the threading and ordering characteristics of Bitcoin Core's shell command notification options. It addresses an open documentation issue where external integrators assume sequential execution, clarifying that commands run concurrently in detached threads and consumers should query the node via RPC for consistent state. The changes are distilled to a concise note and have received an ACK from sedited. Review is complete and the PR is ready for maintainer attention despite 79 days of author inactivity.
